name: 09-sbml-nodes-coupled
title: SBML reactors on a network — diffusive coupling synchronises
question: When a continuous SBML oscillator runs at every node and species diffuse along the edges, does the network synchronise?
hypothesis: Diffusive coupling of per-node Repressilators pulls their phases together, so the across-node spread of a protein collapses toward zero — synchronisation.
objective: Run the repressilator_network_coupled composite (SBML reactors + inter-node transport) and measure across-node synchrony.
description:
With an SBML Repressilator at each node and protein diffusion along the edges, the coupled oscillators synchronise — across-node concentration spread collapses.

Each node runs the Repressilator SBML model integrated by COPASI (reusing viva-copasi); the NetworkTransport process diffuses proteins along edges. Reaction and diffusion are combined by operator splitting each tick. See viz/ for the concentration-on-network animation and the per-node time series.
claim: With an SBML Repressilator at each node and protein diffusion along the edges, the coupled oscillators synchronise — across-node concentration spread collapses.

config.title: SBML reactors on a network — diffusive coupling synchronises
config.subtitle: a Repressilator at each node (viva-copasi); proteins diffuse along the ring

expected_behavior.name: sync-collapses-spread
expected_behavior.condition: across-node protein spread falls far below its initial value
expected_behavior.rationale: Fickian coupling between limit-cycle oscillators entrains their phases.

expected_behavior.name: still-oscillates
expected_behavior.condition: the mean protein level keeps oscillating (not a dead fixed point)
expected_behavior.rationale: Synchronisation aligns phases; it does not quench the oscillation.

behavior_tests.name: coupled-synchronises
behavior_tests.description: Final across-node PX spread is <25% of its initial value.

findings.name: repressilator_network_coupled-result
findings.summary: With an SBML Repressilator at each node and protein diffusion along the edges, the coupled oscillators synchronise — across-node concentration spread collapses.
findings.detail: Nine Repressilators, one per ring node, each integrated by COPASI (via viva-copasi) and coupled by protein diffusion along the edges. Starting at different phases, the oscillators entrain: the across-node PX spread collapses from its initial value toward zero while the mean keeps oscillating — reaction–diffusion synchronisation on a network. This is the headline Family-B capability: continuous, multi-species dynamics ON an evolving network with inter-node transport.

followup_proposals.title: Quorum-sensing coupling via a dedicated signal molecule
followup_proposals.motivation: This study couples by diffusing all three proteins; real cell–cell coupling uses a specific diffusible signal (e.g. an AHL autoinducer), not the internal proteins.
followup_proposals.hypothesized_mechanism: Add a signaling species produced and sensed per node, and diffuse ONLY that molecule along the edges (indirect coupling).
